name: Spherical Harmonics Rotation
definition: Applies analytic rotation matrices to SH coefficients for bands l=1..4 to rotate by ±π/2 around the X-axis. Precomputed as lambda functions operating on float arrays. The minus table is the transpose (inverse) of the plus table.
summary: Spherical Harmonics Rotation computes new coefficients for specific ninety-degree X-axis rotations using precomputed analytic tables, avoiding expensive matrix multiplications.
